report_name: Woodstock and Surrounding Areas Local Cycling and Walking Infrastructure Plan (LCWIP)
how_pct_was_used: The PCT was used to identify cycle desire lines and categorize the network into primary, secondary, and local routes based on forecast flows of people cycling.
other_tools_developed: Route Selection Tool (RST) and Walking Route Audit Tool (WRAT)
specific_evidence_of_impact: The LCWIP provides local policy backing to maximize the ability to secure funding from central government and planning obligations, and has already been updated based on public consultation comments to refine location references and include additional scheme suggestions.
